scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: No elevation supplied: z_floor=0 and ceiling_height=3.0 m are explicit assumptions.
All door leaf heights assumed 2.1 m; window sill 0.9 m / head 2.4 m assumed uniformly; ribbon windows may differ.
Door operating states unknown; swing directions read from arcs only.
Room roles are indicative from furniture; plan-only evidence.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Interior wall thicknesses read from ~8-10 px double-line bands (~240-280 mm); centreplanes used, not individual faces.
Right-wall 1600 door observed at y613-670 while my first reading of the right chain suggested y592-636; pixel jamb ticks and the 5600 bottom segment were preferred.
Whether D_bot/D_right/D_entry leaves are double-leaf is read from arcs; leaf count not dimensioned.
Furniture, text and dimension ink were treated as non-partition; no furniture modelled.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

Vertical chains total 20000 mm: bottom outer face y=877 to 0 m, top outer face y=151 to 20 m (36.3 px/m). Opening extents cross-checked against cyan jamb ticks (left wall y 170/225/311/355/418/473/517/571/684/858; right wall 170/225/311/355/382/556/613/670; top x 268/324/417/591; bottom x 268/326/417/444/537/591). Perimeter representative plane = observed outer wall faces (240 mm walls, band ~8-9 px); interior partitions use measured double-line centreplanes (corridor west x~402, corridor east x~460, top partition y~302, right-side partitions y~371/585, left partitions y~407/589, L-wall y~748/x~460/y~698).

warnings.guidance: x=36.1 px/m and y=36.3 px/m disagree by 0.552486%, over the 0.300000% limit — at least one endpoint pair or transcribed dimension is likely wrong. Do not silently trust the blended px_per_m below: re-crop and re-measure both axes' anchors at their dimension-chain extension-line intersections, then recalibrate. If you must proceed now, prefer the single-axis scale (axis_px_per_m) for geometry measured along that axis over the blended value, and record this disagreement instead of treating the reading as clean.

limits: Two caller-supplied anchors per axis define the transform but do not independently close a dimension chain.
The overlay does not inspect original pixels or automatically decide positional error.

scope.endpoint_selection: exact original image name and linked wall floor

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.
Tangential range and normal displacement are conditional on the caller-supplied axis-aligned calibration.
A dimension extension-line tick may legitimately lie outside its linked finite wall segment; this is a spatial fact, not an error or correctness verdict.
This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.
